slides.title: What Creativity Is, and Why Your Ideas Get Stuck

content_blocks.block_data: What Creativity Is, and Why Your Ideas Get Stuck
Unit 1 · Foundations of Creativity and Innovation · 120 minutes · studio · COs 109.1, 109.2

slides.speaker_notes: Studio session. Warm-up: The Worst Possible Idea. Do not lecture past 15 minutes.

slides.title: The one idea

content_blocks.block_data: Creativity is having ideas. Innovation is an idea that actually reaches somebody. This course is about getting from the first to the second.

slides.speaker_notes: Say it once. Do not elaborate on the slide — elaborate out loud.

slides.title: Why it matters

block_data.body: A tea stall owner invents a new masala — that is creativity. Forty people a day buy it and come back — that is innovation.

block_data.lead: Ideas have a lifecycle, and most die in the middle
block_data.body: Between "I thought of it" and "someone used it" there is a long gap.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: What to do with it

block_data.body: Judging too early. Fear of looking foolish. "We have always done it this way." The expertise trap.

block_data.lead: These are predictable, so they are beatable

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: Today you will

content_blocks.block_data: Pick the one real business you are going to work on for the whole semester. Then write twenty questions you would need to ask its owner.

slides.speaker_notes: Leave this slide up for the whole making phase.

slides.title: To close

block_data.head: Pitch
block_data.body: Three minutes. The person, the stuck, the idea, the picture, the ask.

block_data.head: Critique
block_data.body: I like… / I wish… / What if… — the idea, never the person.

block_data.head: Idea log
block_data.body: One page. Silent. Box 4 is the one you read again in week 15.

slides.speaker_notes: If time runs short, cut the input — never the pitch. The pitch is how CO 109.2 is attained.
